name: Gemma 4 — describe an image (caption)
title: Describe a picture in words
summary: Give it a picture and it writes about it: a description, the exact text it can read, or a prompt to make a similar picture.
description:
Ask Gemma 4 (a vision-language model running in ComfyUI) to describe an image in words. Upload an image and the model writes a caption / description as text — useful on its own, or to turn a picture into a prompt for another workflow.

Edit the instruction to steer the output, e.g. "Describe the image," / "List the main objects." / "Write a short caption." / "Describe the mood and lighting." Change the seed to re-roll the wording.
author: Template - ComfyUI

promptGuides.label: Gemma — understanding pictures (Google)
promptGuides.tip: Ask for exactly what you want back: a description, the text it can read, a list, or a prompt to make a similar picture.
